messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
To compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive, the evidence must be a cited source that directly connects all relevant pieces: our Oscilloscope solution, the Automotive use case, and the named competitor; separate passages that merely mention oscilloscopes, Automotive, or competitors are insufficient for a comparison or recommendation claim [100].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A direct source tying **Oscilloscope** to the **Automotive** application | The available Oscilloscope evidence only states that scopes are used for Interface Test and Power Distribution Network contexts in SerDes / SI / PI validation, and it does not provide model, bandwidth, data rate, test standard, software option, or test conditions [21][42][43]. | Current passages do not directly tie an Oscilloscope solution to Automotive [21][42][43]. |
| A direct source naming the **competitor** in the same Automotive Oscilloscope comparison context | A comparison or recommendation needs a cited passage directly connecting the relevant facets, and separate co-mentions are insufficient [100]. | Current passages do not provide a direct Automotive Oscilloscope competitor comparison [100]. |
| Formal product evidence for our Oscilloscope configuration | Battle-card or positioning material is not binding technical specification; formal specifications / features documents are required for customer-facing technical claims [3][6]. | Current Oscilloscope passages only provide instrument-type mentions and explicitly lack model, bandwidth, data-rate, standard, option, and test-condition details [21][42]. |
| Formal competitor evidence for the competitor’s Oscilloscope configuration | Competitor claims from internal battle cards require competitor official data and third-party evidence before use in customer documents [3][6]. | Current passages do not provide competitor Oscilloscope datasheets, option codes, software versions, or Automotive test conditions [100]. |
| Measurement conditions and limits for any numeric claim | Product numbers should not be used without their conditions; examples in the knowledge base require conditions such as configuration, testing conditions, tolerance limits, calibration, and whether data is binding [54][70]. | Current Oscilloscope passages do not list pass/fail criteria, model, bandwidth, data rate, standards version, software option, or test conditions [21][42]. |
| Source-layer labeling for sales positioning vs. specifications | Battle cards are sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [1][4]. | Any “better,” “fewer boxes,” “lower TCO,” “leadership,” or similar claim would need formal evidence rather than sales language [3][6]. |
### Minimum safe evidence package
A safe comparison needs: our Oscilloscope formal datasheet / features document with model, bandwidth, options, software version, measurement limits, and test conditions; the competitor’s official Oscilloscope datasheet or configuration evidence with the same details; an Automotive test scenario or customer/use-case source directly linking both solutions to that scenario; and, for any performance or TCO claim, the test setup, pass/fail criteria, calibration/configuration assumptions, and calculation basis [21][42][54][70][100].

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Keysight]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Keysight positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform architecture | one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap | multiple UXM SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]] / [[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]] + external tools | battle card 未提供 Keysight 官方資料；R&S one-platform 說法需回查 CMX500 options |
| FR1 / FR2 | quick table 寫 FR1 up to 18 GHz、FR2 up to 50 GHz (RRH evo) | E7515P up to 15 GHz；FR2 split 24.25–29.5 GHz and 37–43.5 GHz | R&S FR1 up to 18 GHz 與正式規格口徑衝突，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| RFU18 / FR3 | [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz；max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz；single-platform FR3 path | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | RFU18 未有正式規格文件；Keysight roadmap 需官方證據 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling possible to integrate in every CMX500 configuration | Wi-Fi only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | CMX500 WLAN options 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]；Keysight 需官方資料 |
| Fading / Doppler / satellite | integrated in one box | [[RaySim]] / [[Channel Studio]] / [[ProbSim]] external for advanced fading and digital twin | source 未列 option code 或正式 workflow |
| IP / application testing | Integrated FTP / HTTP / DNS、IMS、VoNR、VoWiFi | often additional tools and PC | CMX500 application options 需回查正式 features 文件 |
| Software / automation | [[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[CONTEST]]、[[AI Script Assistant]] as one ecosystem | [[Atlas]] + [[Channel Studio]] + [[RaySim]] + WLAN tools + [[Nemo]] + UXM features | AI Script Assistant / CONTEST 在本來源中未提供文件版次；Keysight toolchain 需官方資料 |

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]] 或 Keysight UXM 各型號的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Keysight]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Keysight 官方資料與第三方證據。
- only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO、fewer boxes 等語句是 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- RFU18、FR3、2000 MHz aggregated bandwidth、AI Script Assistant、Keysight RaySim / Atlas / Channel Studio 的正式功能邊界與版本仍需補來源。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Anritsu]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 架構 | one-platform architecture；FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + Wi-Fi + RF + fading | multiple RF boards、external converters、multiple boxes；另依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]，[[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 是 software-based [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，可用 MAC / PHY Digital-IQ / RF interfaces | battle card 未提供正式 CMX500 RFU18 或 Anritsu module datasheet；MX844030PC brochure 未提供 CMX500 比較資料 |
| FR1 bandwidth | quick table: 500 MHz (& future scalable) | 200/400 MHz fixed limit；landmine 稱 max 400 MHz per module | R&S 500 MHz 口徑與既有 specifications 不完全一致，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| FR2 | up to 50 GHz；source claim >16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth；>10 Gbps data rate | up to 43.5 GHz；800 MHz BW；up to 5 Gbps | R&S up to 50.20 GHz 與 specs 方向一致；>16 GHz bandwidth / >10 Gbps 仍缺正式規格來源 |
| FR3 | via upcoming [[RFU18]]；quick table says up to 18 GHz | new FR3 module 0.4–16 GHz | 兩方數字皆需正式 datasheet 驗證 |
| Fading | integrated / native fading | external PC software / chambers / software | source 未列 option code 對照 |
| IP throughput | native high-throughput IP testing | IP Option 012 + external PC | source 未列 throughput profile 或測試條件 |
| Software | single workflow / unified automation / Test Automation Suite | Battle card says SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC；[[mx844030pc-j1200]] says MX844030PC uses common RTD GUI for protocol test case transfer | battle card 是 R&S sales framing；Anritsu brochure 是 MX844030PC official product framing，兩者不可直接合併成單一事實 |
| WLAN | cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform；Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling inside CMX500 | MT8000A no WLAN；requires [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | CMX500 WLAN 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Anritsu]] 的 battle card 主張目前主要來自 R&S internal battle card；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Anritsu 官方資料與第三方證據。
- [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 是 Anritsu product brochure，可用於描述 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]]、[[Anritsu MD8190A]] 與 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，但不可用來驗證 R&S 對 CMX500 的優勢主張。
- Source 中的 only platform、industry-leading、widest frequency range、lower TCO 等語句是 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth 與 data rate 相關矛盾與限制已集中標註於 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]]。

高速互連 probing 與 de-embedding 測試案例 › 可學到的 sales / solution pattern
- 來源明示的 win factor 不是單一儀器規格，而是 total solution：probe、mount-kit、de-embedding tool 與 local partner。這與 [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 中 material measurement / sampling testing / process monitoring 的流程視角互補。
- Bare board for SoCs、socket / transmission line evaluation 與 board-to-board connector DUT 都落在 [[Signal Integrity]]、[[Insertion Loss]]、[[Return Loss]]、[[Impedance]] 與 de-embedding 的交界。
- Samsung 5G SoC including VCO case 顯示 [[R&S FSWP50]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 automated VCO tuning software 可以被包裝成 RF / analog enablement 測試方案，但來源未提供正式 software product name 或 version。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + WLAN + Fading + IP + NTN + RedCap**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system；對比 Keysight 需要 E7515P / E7515B / E7515E、E7515W、E7515R、RaySim / Channel Studio 與 additional tools。
- **FR2 / NTN Conformance Leadership**：主張 CMX500 有 50 GHz mmWave (RRH evo)、FR2 maturity、first validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance with Samsung、RedCap via OBT-Lite。
- **WLAN in Every Configuration**：主張 CMX500 可在每個 configuration 中整合 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling；對比 Keysight Wi-Fi 只在 E7515W 或 E7515P。
- **FR3 / 6G on One Platform**：主張 CMX500 可透過 [[RFU18]] 與 6G-relevant testing 演進，包含 AI-CSI feedback、satellite Doppler、NTN mobility、FR3 channel models；對比 Keysight multi-component approach。
- **Unified Automation**：將 CMsquares、CMsequencer、CONTEST、AI Script Assistant 定位為 one unified environment；對比 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、WLAN-specific tools、Nemo、UXM-specific application features。
- **Simplify the Message**：以 fewer boxes、fewer SKUs、more capability、lower TCO 作為 sales headline。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 矛盾與限制
⚠️ [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）說 quick comparison table 中 [[R&S CMX500]] cellular FR1 up to **18 GHz**、FR2 up to **50 GHz (RRH evo)**，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 說 [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit frequency range **400 MHz to 8000 MHz**，[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF generator **6 GHz to 20 GHz**、IF analyzer **4 GHz to 20 GHz**，FR2 remote radio heads 為 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMXHEAD50]] / [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]]。判斷：battle card quick table 不能取代正式 specifications；FR1 up to 18 GHz 需視為 RFU18 / FR3 roadmap sales wording。

⚠️ [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）說 [[RFU18]] 提供 max aggregated NR bandwidth **2000 MHz**，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 說 [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF bandwidth **250 MHz**、[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF analyzer bandwidth up to **1 GHz**，且 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 說 IF unit 最高 **800 MHz total carrier bandwidth**、NR FR2 channel bandwidth **50 / 100 / 200 / 400 MHz**。判斷：2000 MHz 屬 RFU18 / roadmap sales claim，不可回填為既有 CMX500 binding specification。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？
5. 是否需要 validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance（RF + RRM + PCT）with ecosystem partner，以因應 operator 或 certification pressure？
6. 轉向 FR3 時，是否要 upgrade same platform（例如 add an RF unit），或導入 new boxes and new software？
7. RedCap testing 是否要在 main 5G signaling tester 中，或能接受 separate RedCap-only box？
8. Operators 或 certification bodies 是否要求 specific timeline 上的 validated NR-NTN conformance？
9. 團隊需要學習與維護多少不同 software environments，且 tool updates 是否會破壞 automation？

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 Keysight 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 提供 one-platform integration，涵蓋 cellular FR1 / FR2 / FR3 path、Wi-Fi、fading、IP/application testing、NTN、RedCap、RF analysis 與 signaling；相對地，Keysight 被描述為依賴 multiple UXM SKUs、add-on software 與 external tools。

1. 是否需要 FR1 bandwidth beyond 400 MHz，例如 600–800 MHz per carrier for 5G-Advanced Rel-18 / Rel-19 testing？
2. 是否需要 FR1、FR2、FR3、WLAN 與 LTE 在 single instrument 中且不用 hardware swaps？
3. 是否需要 native fading with high-throughput IP testing？
4. 是否偏好 one unified software platform，而不是 four separate tools？
5. 是否需要 advanced CA 或 mobility without adding extra boxes？
6. 是否需要 FR3 testing beyond 16 GHz，以支援 emerging 6G FR3 evaluations？

[[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）是 Anritsu 對 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 的 product brochure，確認 MX844030PC 為 **Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software**，支援 MAC-IF、PHY-IF Digital-IQ 與 RF-IF for RedCap，並使用 common [[RTD]] GUI 連接 Pre-silicon / Post-silicon protocol testing workflow。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + Fading + IP**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system，對比 Anritsu 的 MT8000A、MT8862A、IP Option 012 + external PC、external fading chambers 與 separate RF boards。

- **R&D → Conformance → Production**：CMX500、CMW500、CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 構成 one vendor / one workflow / full lifecycle。
- **Future-proof technology**：Validated NTN、ORAN ORU / Conformance with partners、FR3 beyond 16 GHz、RedCap Rel-17/18。
- **Unified software ecosystem**：R&S Test Automation Suite 與 unified user experience；對比 Anritsu SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC。此項與 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 對 MX844030PC common RTD GUI 的說明並列保留，使用時需標明來源層次。
- **Fewer Boxes. More Capability.**：以 fewer calibrations、fewer licenses、lower TCO、higher test throughput 作為 sales message；來源未提供 TCO 算式。

- 來源稱 [[Anritsu]] mobile test portfolio 是 fragmented、multi-hardware architecture，用於 [[4G]] / [[5G]] / [[6G]] testing。
- 來源列出的 Anritsu 產品組合包含 [[Anritsu MT8000A]]（5G NR FR1/FR2/FR3）、[[Anritsu MD8475B]]（LTE/IMS/eCall）、[[Anritsu MT8821C]]（LTE/LTE-A/3G/2G RF）、[[Anritsu MT8862A]]（Wi-Fi）與 [[Anritsu MT8852B]]（Bluetooth）。

- 來源的 sales landmines 聚焦在 FR1 wideband beyond 400 MHz、FR1+FR2+FR3+WLAN+LTE one-box、integrated fading + IP load、unified software、multi-cell / CA / mobility without extra boxes，以及 FR3 frequency headroom beyond 16 GHz。
- 來源的 R&S offensive plays 包含 one-box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP、FR2 / FR3 performance leadership、integrated WLAN signaling、R&D → conformance → production lifecycle、future-proof RedCap / NTN / ORAN / 6G、unified software ecosystem，以及 fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput 的簡化訊息。

RAR UL Grant › SUL / NUL target carrier routing
依 [[SUL RACH procedure]]：

- [[Msg2]] 的 [[Random Access Response]] [[PDSCH]] payload and [[Msg3]] grant need to be routed to target carrier（[[Normal Uplink carrier]] or [[SUL carrier]]）。
- The target carrier is same to carrier that [[PRACH]] is transmitted on。
- [[Msg3]] [[PUSCH]] transmission is on target carrier。
- A UE transmits [[PRACH]] and the [[PUSCH]] on a same uplink carrier of a same serving cell。
- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 38.213]] Section 8.3：UE always transmits the PUSCH scheduled by a RAR UL grant without repetitions。

### Short answer
To compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive, the evidence must be a cited source that directly connects all relevant pieces: our Oscilloscope solution, the Automotive use case, and the named competitor; separate passages that merely mention oscilloscopes, Automotive, or competitors are insufficient for a comparison or recommendation claim [100].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A direct source tying **Oscilloscope** to the **Automotive** application | The available Oscilloscope evidence only states that scopes are used for Interface Test and Power Distribution Network contexts in SerDes / SI / PI validation, and it does not provide model, bandwidth, data rate, test standard, software option, or test conditions [21][42][43]. | Current passages do not directly tie an Oscilloscope solution to Automotive [21][42][43]. |
| A direct source naming the **competitor** in the same Automotive Oscilloscope comparison context | A comparison or recommendation needs a cited passage directly connecting the relevant facets, and separate co-mentions are insufficient [100]. | Current passages do not provide a direct Automotive Oscilloscope competitor comparison [100]. |
| Formal product evidence for our Oscilloscope configuration | Battle-card or positioning material is not binding technical specification; formal specifications / features documents are required for customer-facing technical claims [3][6]. | Current Oscilloscope passages only provide instrument-type mentions and explicitly lack model, bandwidth, data-rate, standard, option, and test-condition details [21][42]. |
| Formal competitor evidence for the competitor’s Oscilloscope configuration | Competitor claims from internal battle cards require competitor official data and third-party evidence before use in customer documents [3][6]. | Current passages do not provide competitor Oscilloscope datasheets, option codes, software versions, or Automotive test conditions [100]. |
| Measurement conditions and limits for any numeric claim | Product numbers should not be used without their conditions; examples in the knowledge base require conditions such as configuration, testing conditions, tolerance limits, calibration, and whether data is binding [54][70]. | Current Oscilloscope passages do not list pass/fail criteria, model, bandwidth, data rate, standards version, software option, or test conditions [21][42]. |
| Source-layer labeling for sales positioning vs. specifications | Battle cards are sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [1][4]. | Any “better,” “fewer boxes,” “lower TCO,” “leadership,” or similar claim would need formal evidence rather than sales language [3][6]. |
### Minimum safe evidence package
A safe comparison needs: our Oscilloscope formal datasheet / features document with model, bandwidth, options, software version, measurement limits, and test conditions; the competitor’s official Oscilloscope datasheet or configuration evidence with the same details; an Automotive test scenario or customer/use-case source directly linking both solutions to that scenario; and, for any performance or TCO claim, the test setup, pass/fail criteria, calibration/configuration assumptions, and calculation basis [21][42][54][70][100].
